reviews.t: Great Christmas present.  Ideal for travel.
reviews.x: The product looks great and is very light weight.  It feels good in your hand.  It came already charged so I could use it right out of the box.  It gives a nice, close shave without pulling or pinching as some electric razors can do.  Cleaning is very easy.  Just pop the top off and shake or use brush that is included.  The sideburn trimmer works great as well.  The 15 month warranty is a nice feature.  Overall, it's unbelievable what you get for this price.  Even for those who do not use an ele

I got this for my husband for Christmas.  So it sat in the box for almost a month, and by the time he used it, the boxes were thrown out.  It does not work anymore.  My husband got a few shaves from it, but the shaves were not even close to his old broken down shaver.  DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!! Go with a GOOD BRAND NAME!  One thing to remember........YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR!

I've replaced the heads every year for 11 years and the cutting quality of the heads seem to decrease each year.  So time to try something new. reviews.t: If you like pain, this razor is for you!
reviews.x: Charged the razor and attempted to use it for the 1st time.  I hadn't shaved for 2 days due to my old razor breaking so I had more than a 5 o'clock shadow.  This razor didn't shave smoothly at all and seemed like it was just pulling the hair out.  Very painful.  Decided the next morning to try it wet and was no better.  Spend a little more money and get a name brand.

I have used this razor everyday for two weeks. It's surprised to cost about as much as the replacement heads for the razor but it works very well. Highly recommend it as the second razor in the car, easy charing with USB cable.

I have used Norelco products for over 20 years. This year I got a gift, Aesfee electric shaver. The closeness of the shave, the ability to use preshave and the way the head can get close to trim around ears. Dry shave and wet shave are both pretty good.
It's a nice shaver to have. Runs quietly and smoothly. It's washable too.

This is the first electric razor I purchased for my teenage son and he loves it! It's easy to use, great battery life and does a superb job (especially considering he's still learning). Very pleased with this purchase!

reviews.t: Simple and Stable would be best
reviews.x: Since I found my broken Philips shaver was not worth its cost, when I found Aesfee Shaver, it is affordable but its blade is effective and quieter.  In additional, Aesfee's package looks great and light weight, and accessory is good enough for me.  Overall, it's valuable product what you get for affordable price. The best for your own needs would be a smart choice.
I just used it out of the box because  it was fully charged. It worked very well and i liked its touch on my face. It was a very smooth and clean experience.  I liked every  bit of it.

reviews.t: Does not last.. save your money..
reviews.x: Worked great for a few months. Work up one morning and the shaver was on. Display was blinking and I couldn’t turn it off. Now it won’t charge or nothing.

reviews.t: Painful razor with a bad trimmer
reviews.x: I hated it as soon as I used it. Even with close trims, the upper rings were constantly ripping hairs rather than trimming them. The trim tab is very small, so the rings can easily cut hair on the side of your head, and any facial hair on your chin if you trim your neck. My skin felt very raw after using the shaver, and it even left a number of cuts on my neck. I never thought I'd have to stop shaving because of the raw burning a shaver could cause, but that is what happened.

Decided to get the electric shaver after years of using disposable blades. Finally I got sick of buying them every once in a while. Decided to get this shaver because it seems small enough and pretty handy. Been using it for a week and I have to say I’m pretty impressed. Don’t know why haven’t i gotten a while back. The shaving experience is pretty smooth, didn’t encounter any issues with the battery so far. Overall I recommend this shaver to every dude out there.

The waterproofing is excellent. It cuts your beard and hair but it is way under powered and will actually bog down if you push it like a normal shaver. II have to run it over the same spot 4-5 times to get a decent shave. What you get in the ability to shave in the shower is a trade off in time and not being able to save any time. I gave it 3 stars because it could be 5 with just a little more power to actually save time.

reviews.t: As good as the big name companies
reviews.x: Works very well, easy to charge and clean. displays battery life very clearly.  Very smooth and does not pull on the hairs as some razors do.  I have not had it to long but I am very impressed so far
My husband loves this shaver. This thing is powerful for being cordless. His face has never been so smooth. I highly recommend this product.
Pretty decent product. Can’t wait to use it.

reviews.t: Died at 1st charging, NO replacement, No repsonse for Manufacture, Distributor or AMAZON.
reviews.x: This product was OK until I attempted to re-charge it.  It was recharged 21 reading on the Battery Life meter. Plugged in and began charging, when I can back to check it the readout was blank and the shaver was DEAD- NO LIGHT and NO CHARGE. Of course the short warranty had expired and I recieved NO RESPONSE FROM the COMPANY or Amazon for that matter. I suggest you stay with the proven models of other proven companies.

reviews.t: Great shaver, worth trying feedback after using more than one week

Charging quickly and last quite long time. Outside looking really nice and feeling very good in the hand. It is a nice purchasing experiance

I have no idea why this is and doesn't make much sense other than the head on this unit seems much sturdier and holds the blades in tighter with less give when shaving. So I tried this.  After a short trial, I have to say that I am getting a noticeably closer shave. claims.text: Many customers find the shaver quiet, smooth, and easy to use, delivering a close and comfortable shave.
Several reviewers praise the value, noting it is affordable and comes fully charged and ready to use out of the box.
A notable number of negative reviewers report the razor pulling or ripping hairs and causing pain or raw skin.
Some customers report durability problems, with the shaver failing or breaking after only a few months of use.
A few reviewers were disappointed overall and recommend sticking with name brands instead.

qa.q: Is it really waterproof for use in the shower?
qa.answer: One review states the waterproofing is excellent and mentions the ability to shave in the shower [1], but no review explicitly confirms it is fully waterproof for shower use beyond that. Another reviewer tried it wet and found it no better, though they did not report water damage [5].

claims.text: The waterproofing is excellent and it can be used to shave in the shower.
Trying it wet was no better than dry, but no water damage was reported.

qa.q: How close of a shave does it give compared to a blade?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on closeness: several say it gives a very close or noticeably closer shave [1][2][3][6], while one says the shaves were not even close to an old broken-down shaver [4]. None directly compare it to a blade razor.

claims.text: Some reviewers report a very close or noticeably closer shave.
One reviewer says the shaves were not even close to an old broken-down shaver.

qa.q: How long does the battery last on a full charge?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it pull or irritate sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some report pulling, pain, and raw or cut skin [1][3], while others describe the shave as comfortable [4].

claims.text: One reviewer said the upper rings ripped hairs, skin felt raw, and it left cuts on the neck.
Another reviewer said it seemed to pull hair out and was very painful, both dry and wet.
A different reviewer found the shave more comfortable.

qa.answer: No, reviews describe it as quiet when running [1][2][5].

claims.text: It is a lot quieter than a previous shaver.
